about_the_game:
Art Together is a multiplayer drawing game where creativity meets chaos. Gather people online and experience the hilarious results of collaborative art creation!

Features:

  • Watch your drawings evolve (or devolve) as they pass from player to player, creating amusing misinterpretations and unexpected results.

  • No artistic skills required! Even with zero drawing ability, your effort and enthusiasm will lead to fantastic results.

  • Customizable lobby settings to tailor the experience to your preferences.

  • Simple, intuitive controls that anyone can pick up within seconds.

  • Save your favorite creations - preserve the most hilarious moments for posterity!

Whether you're already skilled with a pencil or completely new to drawing, Art Together offers a fun way to practice your skills. Who knows? This game might even spark your passion for the visual arts!

Grab your mouse or drawing tablet and prepare for an art experience where the journey is far more important than the destination!
